cases.name: ignored_custom_scalar_tag
cases.rationale: A custom tag on an ignored annotation should not change kinetics; this expectation may expose a baseline flatten limitation.

cases.name: ignored_custom_sequence_tag
cases.rationale: An ignored tagged collection should leave every parsed mechanism field unchanged; baseline acceptance is not assumed observed.

cases.name: tagged_species_external_mapping
cases.rationale: A tagged external selector remains outside the portable species subset and must identify owner and offending reference.

cases.name: custom_tag_rate_scalar
cases.rationale: An application-specific tag on the untagged numeric/text rate union is expected to refuse admission rather than silently strip type information.

cases.name: ordinary_merge_document
cases.rationale: Ordinary merge key is an unsupported document section; automatic merge expansion must not supply kinetics fields.

cases.name: ordinary_merge_phase
cases.rationale: A merge key on a phase remains an unsupported field even if its payload consists of ignorable data.

cases.name: ordinary_merge_species
cases.rationale: A merge key on a species must retain its field refusal rather than silently materialize its payload.

cases.name: ignored_nested_merge_alias
cases.rationale: Anchors and an ordinary merge key wholly within ignored notes have no kinetic meaning and should remain harmless.

cases.name: duplicate_document_annotation
cases.rationale: Repeated flattened annotation entries are expected to overwrite irrelevant metadata without altering the mechanism.

cases.name: duplicate_known_rate_field
cases.rationale: Repeated known rate fields are ambiguous typed input and must be refused before mechanism validation.

cases.name: duplicate_composition_last_value
cases.rationale: A typed composition map is expected to keep its last H entry, exactly reproducing the independently authored ordinary witness.

cases.name: duplicate_nested_annotation_key
cases.rationale: Duplicate keys inside a generic annotation value are expected to retain YAML Value duplicate-entry refusal, distinguishing this from flattened outer metadata.

scope: Prospective source-informed synthetic YAML admission engineering controls; independently authored supplement, not blind chemistry forecasts or empirical kinetic accuracy.
limits: Original 50 fixtures and all existing baseline/candidate outcomes remain immutable and separate.
Custom-tag, duplicate-annotation and duplicate-composition expectations are prospective and may fail on accepted main; such failures must be preserved and adjudicated explicitly.
Positive controls compare complete ParsedMechanism values, not only summaries.
Refusal controls bind public domain categories and owners/fields where applicable; YAML parser message wording is not pinned.
No parser fuzzing, full YAML language guarantee, performance, solver accuracy or complete integration acceptance.
execution: Not executed on baseline or candidate; syntax/static checks only.
